title: reckon-scheduled-task
description: A scheduled task: a job set to run on a host. The STIX common properties come from the STIX 2.1 core schema, so this schema lists only the ones it constrains.

path.description: The path of the task's file.

command_line.description: The first command the task runs.

command_lines.description: Every command the task runs, when it runs more than one.

principal_user_ref.description: The account the task runs as, as a user-account id, or empty.
